brief: Breakout timing: Now. Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps lists 100+ AI agents and RAG apps for automation.
Opportunity: Build a curated marketplace for these tools, or a no-code platform to compose them.

Risk: Need to vet quality of listed tools, and ensure compliance with open-source licenses.
